fato_historico: 1695: Henry Every perpetrates one of the most profitable pirate raids in history with the capture of the Grand Mughal ship Ganj-i-Sawai. In response, Emperor Aurangzeb threatens to end all English trading in India.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to safeguard the emotional riches you carry within. Just as history once witnessed a grand quest for golden spoils on the high seas, you may feel an urge to protect your own precious inner world. It is a good time to value your personal treasures and keep your heart's bounty anchored in peace.
frase_do_dia: True prosperity flows from the wealth you cultivate within your own kind heart.
significado_numero: A powerful symbol representing the alignment of wisdom and inner strength.
conselho: Consider setting boundaries to protect the golden light of your beautiful spirit today.
